title: Dealer contact and suggested next steps
summary: This topic centers on service writers suggesting actions such as activating features, monitoring issues, practicing usage, or contacting a dealer for inspection, inventory, or follow-up.

positive.summary: One positive review says a writer suggested activating a feature that would likely improve customer satisfaction.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe suggested follow-up actions that did not resolve underlying concerns, including monitoring recurring issues, seeking diagnosis, or relying on temporary fixes.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly report suggested guidance or explanations, such as visiting a dealership, contacting staff, practicing use, monitoring behavior, or following charging advice, without clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, which limits confident interpretation of overall customer sentiment.

The cluster spans several unrelated subjects, including feature activation, charging guidance, trunk behavior, camera washing, inventory inquiries, and dealership follow-up, so it is not a single coherent issue.
Examples are brief and often describe writer recommendations rather than the customer outcome, so the impact of the suggested actions is often unclear.
